name: matches the interview example
input: hello, delete 2, insert world, move, delete, and move
test:
editor = TextEditor()
editor.addText('hello')
assert editor.deleteText(2) == 2
editor.addText('world')
assert editor.cursorLeft(3) == 'helwo'
assert editor.cursorRight(4) == 'helworld'
assert editor.deleteText(5) == 5
assert editor.cursorLeft(1) == 'he'
assert editor.cursorRight(2) == 'hel'

name: stops at cursor boundaries and returns only the final ten left characters
input: eleven characters and cursor moves larger than the text
test:
editor = TextEditor()
editor.addText('abcdefghijk')
assert editor.cursorLeft(100) == ''
assert editor.deleteText(4) == 0
assert editor.cursorRight(100) == 'bcdefghijk'
assert editor.deleteText(100) == 11
assert editor.cursorLeft(1) == ''

name: inserts and deletes in the middle without dropping right-side text
test:
editor = TextEditor()
editor.addText('world')
assert editor.cursorLeft(2) == 'wor'
editor.addText('_')
assert editor.cursorRight(10) == 'wor_ld'
assert editor.cursorLeft(2) == 'wor_'
assert editor.deleteText(10) == 4
assert editor.cursorRight(10) == 'ld'
